topline: Meta plans to raise up to $95bn by selling new shares to fund AI; the stock fell 1.9% and Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom may each buy up to $5bn.
Anthropic's IPO filing lifted tech: Nasdaq +0.8%, Nvidia +2.4%, and it shows how tied in Amazon and Alphabet are as investors and cloud suppliers.
